purpose: Inline caret-anchored slash-command list for textareas and single-line text inputs.
useWhen: Showing a contextual command list at the caret while a user types in a textarea or input.
Building slash-command insertion flows where the host owns text replacement.

avoidWhen.reason: Exposing a global app launcher — use command-palette instead.
Selecting from a static form option list — use combobox instead.
